caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a standing female figure, labeled “INDIAN MAIDEN” at the bottom in capital letters. The figure is depicted frontally, wearing a draped garment that covers her body and falls in folds to her feet, with the left hand holding part of the garment at her chest and the right arm resting at her side. The head features carved, wavy hair and a headband or decorative headdress. The statue stands on a simple rectangular base, with a scroll-like ornament at the lower left near the feet. The wood exhibits a weathered, aged appearance, with visible cracks, chips, and sections where the surface layer is missing, notably on the lower part of the legs and drapery, revealing a lighter wood beneath a grayish, worn surface. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, without any additional objects or scenery. The overall palette consists of natural wood tones, with shades of gray, brown, and tan predominant in the statue.
title: Circus Wagon Figure
